
# Load data

```{r} 
# Standard data
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS")
tr <- read.tree("./data/tree/tree.treefile") 

## KPC Plasmids 
KPC_info_clusters <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid/KPC_containing_clusters_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame 
KPC_containing_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="KPC Plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame%>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
cluster_KPC_containing_clusters <- Heatmap(KPC_containing_clusters)
plasmid_order <- colnames(KPC_containing_clusters[column_order(cluster_KPC_containing_clusters)])

KPC_clusters <- colnames(KPC_containing_clusters) 
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))  

## BLBLI clustering
pclustering <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr_clustering_df.RDS")
blbli_asr <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr.RDS")
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))  
df <- left_join(df,pclustering %>% select(isolate_no,blbli_asr_cluster_renamed))
df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed_simple <- recode(df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed,"No Feature"="Susceptible" )

# KPC_copy number
KPC_copy_number <- readRDS("./data/KPC_coverage/normalized/KPNIH1_KPC_plasmid_depth_by_feature_median_chromosome_normalized.RDS") %>% select(KPNIH1_RS28775_chr_median_norm) %>% rename(KPC_copy_number=KPNIH1_RS28775_chr_median_norm) %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.))

df <- left_join(df,KPC_copy_number)

df$KPC_plasmid <- sapply(df$isolate_no,FUN=function(x){
  plasmid <- KPC_containing_clusters %>% subset(rownames(.)==x) %>% colSums(.) %>% subset(.>0)%>% names()
  ifelse(length(plasmid)==0,"No Plasmid",plasmid)
}) %>% unlist

# KPC plasmid copy number
KPC_plasmid_copy_number <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid_coverage/KPC_plasmid_copy_number_chromosome_normalized.RDS")
df <- left_join(df,KPC_plasmid_copy_number)

# KPC gene
KPC_data <- read.table("./data/KPC_blast/KPC_blast_master.txt",header = T)  
KPC_data$KPC_allele <- paste0("bla",str_split(KPC_data$sseqid,"\\|",simplify = T) %>% .[,ncol(.)])
df <- left_join(df,KPC_data %>% select(isolate_no,KPC_allele))
df$KPC_allele <- ifelse(is.na(df$KPC_allele),"No blaKPC",df$KPC_allele)  
```

```{r,fig.height=6.75,fig.width=7.5}
df$KPC_copy_number_log2 <- log2(df$KPC_copy_number)

rownames(df) <- df$isolate_no
font_size =  2.75
font_family = "Arial"

p1.1 <- p1+ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()

p2 <- gheatmap(p1.1,data=df %>% select(MVB_log_2,IR_log_2) %>% mutate_all(as.factor) %>% `colnames<-`(c("Meropenem-vaborbactam MIC","Imipenem-relebactam MIC")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = font_size, width = 0.1,offset=.000025,family = font_family) + Log2_scale_s6 + ylim(NA,550) + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md
  
p2.1 <- p2+ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()

p3 <- gheatmap(p2.1,data=df %>% select(KPC_allele) %>% `colnames<-`(c("blaKPC allele")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = font_size, width = 0.05,offset=.00005,family = font_family) + kpc_scale + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md   + guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
        title.position = "top",
        label.position = "right",
        order=4,
        ncol = 1,theme = theme(legend.title = element_markdown(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
                 legend.text  = element_markdown(size = 6))
    )
) 

p3.1 <- p3+ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()

p4 <- gheatmap(p3.1,data=df %>% select(KPC_plasmid_copy_number_log2,KPC_copy_number_log2) %>% `colnames<-`(c("log2 blaKPC plasmid copy number","log2 blaKPC gene copy number")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = font_size, width = 0.1,offset=.00006125,family = font_family)    +consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md   + log2_cont_scale_s6 + ylim(NA,550)   

p4.1 <- p4 + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()
  
figure <- gheatmap(p4.1,data=KPC_containing_clusters[,plasmid_order] %>% mutate_all(as.factor) %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.) %>% gsub("_KPC","",.)," blaKPC-containing plasmid")), colnames_position = "top",colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, color = NA, font.size = font_size, width = 0.5,offset =.0000875,family = font_family) + plasmid_scale_v + ylim(NA,570)   + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md  
``` 

```{r,fig.height=6.75,fig.width=6.75}
# Legend from real data, using the same scale as the panel
data_legend <- function(data, var, scale, continuous = FALSE, extra = NULL) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[var]]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!continuous) data[[var]] <- factor(data[[var]])
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = 1, y = 1, fill = .data[[var]])) + geom_tile() +
    scale + consistent_theme_s_figure_6_wo_md
  if (!is.null(extra)) p <- p + extra                       # e.g. markdown guide for blaKPC
  cowplot::get_legend(p)
}

# blaKPC allele: markdown title and labels (italic bla, subscript KPC)
kpc_md_guide <- guides(fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", label.position = "right", order = 4, ncol = 1,
                                           theme = theme(legend.title = element_markdown(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
                                                         legend.text  = element_markdown(size = 6))))

leg_phylo <- data_legend(df, "blbli_asr_cluster_renamed", cluster_scale_1_order_2_col)
leg_res   <- data_legend(df, "blbli_dich", resistance_scale_order_2)
leg_mic   <- data_legend(df, "MVB_log_2", Log2_scale_gwas_figure)
leg_kpc   <- data_legend(df, "KPC_allele", kpc_scale, extra = kpc_md_guide)
leg_cn    <- data_legend(df, "KPC_copy_number_log2", log2_cont_scale_s6, continuous = TRUE)
leg_plas  <- data_legend(data.frame(p = as.vector(as.matrix(KPC_containing_clusters))), "p", plasmid_scale_v)

# One row: all six legends (row_legends() from S Figure 3) 
row_legends <- function(legs, fig_w = 7.5, gap = 0.12) {
  w <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths),  "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
  h <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
  # Pad the bottom of each legend to match the tallest, so all titles line up
  legs <- mapply(function(g, hi) gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, unit(max(h) - hi, "in"), pos = -1),
                 legs, h, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
  pad <- max((fig_w - sum(w) - gap * (length(legs) - 1)) / 2, 0)
  rel <- c(pad, as.vector(rbind(w, gap))[-2 * length(w)], pad)
  # Interleave legends with NULL spacers: NULL, leg1, NULL, leg2, ..., NULL
  cells <- c(list(NULL),
             unlist(lapply(seq_along(legs), function(i)
               if (i < length(legs)) list(legs[[i]], NULL) else list(legs[[i]])),
               recursive = FALSE),
             list(NULL))
  out <- do.call(plot_grid, c(cells, list(nrow = 1, rel_widths = rel)))
  attr(out, "height_in") <- max(h)                              # row height (in)
  attr(out, "width_in")  <- sum(w) + gap * (length(legs) - 1)   # row width (in)
  out
}

legends  <- row_legends(list(leg_phylo,leg_res ,leg_mic, leg_kpc, leg_cn, leg_plas),
                        fig_w = 6.75, gap = 0.03)
attr(legends, "width_in")                                   # must be <= 7.5
legend_h <- attr(legends, "height_in")

# Tree without its legends + legend row; total height 7.5 in
fig_h  <- 6.75
tree_h <- fig_h - legend_h
s_figure_6 <- plot_grid(figure + theme(legend.position = "none"), legends,
                        ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(tree_h, legend_h))

s_figure_6
```
